versions.changelog:
- Initial release of dca-weekly strategy for recurring, calendar-based scheduled buys (DCA) on Superior Trade.
- Supports weekly, daily, or monthly accumulator strategies with one open trade per pair and consistent position growth via calendar triggers.
- Uses Freqtrade primitives: position_adjustment_enable, max_entry_position_adjustment, max_dca_multiplier, custom_stake_amount, and adjust_trade_position callbacks.
- Includes full reference implementation and backtest results, with configuration examples and common pitfalls.
- Variants and extensions for different cadences, drawdown-aware buys, and spot vs futures are documented.
